description: Presidential Secretariat - Ministry of Higher Education and Highways in the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1933/13 dated 21.05.2015, which was amended from time to time will be removed from Gaz. Notification relating to subject and Functions of Ministries and it will be deemed as not coming under the  purview of any Ministry with effect from May 16, 2017
categorisation: This gazette notification describes a structural/administrative change regarding the removal of the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology from the purview of any Ministry. It involves government organization (changing which ministry an institution falls under) but does not name any specific individuals or describe detailed portfolio responsibilities for any person. The mention of the President is in his official capacity as the authority making the notification, not as part of a personnel appointment with detailed responsibilities.
